name: PubCrawl
description: PubCrawl gives Claude real-time access to PubMed, FDA prescribing information, UK drug labelling, and ClinicalTrials.gov. Search the biomedical literature, retrieve structured abstracts and full-text papers, compare US and UK drug labels side by side, and find recruiting clinical trials - all grounded in live, verified data. No API keys, no account required. Built for medical writers, researchers, and pharmaceutical professionals who need citations they can actually trust.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PubCrawl to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PubCrawl to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://pubcrawl-production-feb9.up.railway.app/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PubCrawl MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PubCrawl provides these MCP tools: search_pubmed, get_abstract, get_full_text, find_related, format_citation, trending_papers, get_uspi, get_smpc, compare_labels, search_by_indication, search_trials, and get_trial.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PubCrawl?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to PubCrawl in healthcare on the Manufact MCP catalog include Virtual Fly Brain, Aniva, ClinicalTrials.gov Explorer (by BLEN), Health Data Avatar (HDA), and KORE.
PubCrawl does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
PubCrawl is developed by PharmaTools.AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
